title: 📱 Japanese-style candid airline snapsho
prompt:
📱 Japanese-style candid airline snapshot, 3:4 aspect ratio. A beautiful East Asian woman, explicitly an adult aged 18–22, approximately 1.75 m tall, with delicate, sweet facial features, cool porcelain-fair skin, a tall, slender model-like figure, and a naturally proportioned bust visually around an E cup. An elegant updo; a deep-V white blouse paired with a navy flight-attendant vest and a short blue-and-white striped skirt; a yellow silk scarf, black mid-heel shoes, and sheer black stockings.
✈️ Set near an aircraft cabin door, with a fold-down jump seat, door handle, warning signs, and overhead luggage compartments naturally visible in the frame. Cool gray, low-saturation tones; a tilted, handheld smartphone composition; diffused overhead lighting; slight overexposure, image noise, and soft focus around the edges. Fresh, sheer, white-peach-toned “no-makeup” makeup and an authentic amateur snapshot feel.
Random pose pool:
💺 Sitting on the fold-down jump seat with one leg bent, raising a hand to adjust her updo
✈️ Sitting sideways beside the cabin door, looking back with a sweet smile
🧣 Looking down while adjusting her scarf, then suddenly glancing up at the camera
👜 Bending over to rummage through a small personal bag, captured mid-motion
🙆🏻‍♀️ Leaning against the seat back and stretching in a naturally relaxed pose
🪞 Standing up while straightening her vest and skirt hem, turning sideways toward the camera
💬 Sitting with her chin resting on one hand, daydreaming, her legs naturally staggered
🚪 Holding the edge of the cabin doorway as she stands up, looking back with a smile  
🎲 Randomly select a pose, then freely vary the camera angle, cabin details, expression, handheld tilt, and soft-focus effects. Aim for a blend of flight-attendant uniform styling, Japanese lifestyle portrait photography, and a spontaneous smartphone snapshot.
